column1: #     Subtype 0x41 = a second undefined/raw data partition (0x40 is prompts above): the
#     browser flasher writes a single 256-byte fixed-layout record here at install time
#     carrying the SoftAP WPA2 passphrase
#     headless esp32s3-wifi/esp32s3-eth board — which has no screen to read a generated
#     passphrase off — can be configured before it ever boots. See DeviceConfig.hpp for
#     the authoritative wire format (magic/version/flags/gen + CRC-32).
#   * The FIRMWARE ONLY EVER READS THIS PARTITION. DeviceConfig::applyFlashSeed() reads
#     the 256 bytes once at boot and writes the settings into NVS; nothing in the
#     firmware calls esp_partition_write() or esp_partition_erase_range() on cfgseed.
#     The erase-before-write discipline documented above for raw 0x40 therefore does not
#     apply here — the only writer is the flasher

#     missing cfgseed partition is the NORMAL case
